Some vocations have special places that only they can enter, and druids are no exception. Cross the {wiki:Magic Forcefield} in the Plains of Havoc to reach the {wiki:Isle of the Mists} and collect 2 {item:Small Emerald|Small Emeralds} and a {item:Book} from the box and the drawer on the ground floor.
Some Tibia vocations have special places that only that vocation can enter. Druids are no exception. If you are a druid, try to find your own place and you will receive your prize.
Magic Forcefield in the Plains of Havoc
**Druid** vocation (it is the druids' special place).
On the way through the {wiki:Plains of Havoc} you may find {creature:Giant Spider|Giant Spiders}: go prepared.
1. Get to the Isle of the Mists
Get to the Plains of Havoc

Leave {wiki:Venore} on foot and head **southwest** to the {wiki:Plains of Havoc}, southeast of {wiki:Kazordoon}. In the middle of the plains is the temple of {npc:Oldrak} (on the 1st floor above ground), where you can rest. The island's {wiki:Magic Forcefield} is **south** of that temple.
Go to the {wiki:Plains of Havoc} and enter the {wiki:Magic Forcefield}, near some {creature:Orc|Orcs}. You are teleported to the {wiki:Isle of the Mists}.
You may find {creature:Giant Spider|Giant Spiders} on the way.
Open the box and the drawer
On the **ground floor** of the island you find a {item:Box} and a {item:Drawer}. Open them to collect 2 {item:Small Emerald|Small Emeralds} and a {item:Book}.
Sometimes {creature:Fernfang} appears on the upper floor.
3. Leave the Isle of the Mists
Back to the Plains of Havoc

TibiaWiki does not describe how to leave the island: go back to the spot where you appeared after crossing the {wiki:Magic Forcefield} and look for the way back to the {wiki:Plains of Havoc} from there. Once on the plains, head **northeast** to {wiki:Venore} (or rest in the temple of {npc:Oldrak}).
Before you leave, make sure you have already opened the {item:Box} and the {item:Drawer} on the ground floor.
